responsibility: This machine-description fragment implements GCC’s RTL instruction-selection support for the Loongson multimedia/vector extension used by Loongson-class MIPS targets. It defines Loongson-specific UNSPEC codes, vector mode iterators and attributes, move and vector-initialization expanders, and a broad set of SIMD patterns for packed arithmetic, comparisons, shuffles, unpack/pack, whole-register shifts, extraction, and reduction helpers, relying on backend routines such as mips_legitimize_move, mips_expand_vector_init, mips_expand_vec_unpack, and mips_expand_vec_reduc to bridge generic vector operations and builtins onto the Loongson MMI instruction encodings when TARGET_LOONGSON_VECTORS is enabled.
same_name_distinction: Unlike gcc/config/mips/loongson.h, which is a user-facing C intrinsic header for Loongson vector operations, this .md file is the backend machine-description source that teaches GCC how to recognize and emit those Loongson MMI instructions. It defines RTL unspecs, mode iterators, expanders, and instruction patterns under TARGET_LOONGSON_VECTORS rather than declaring inline intrinsics or compatibility includes.
